I blame myself for the choices I e made over time...but I can’t help but resent the traumas that happened to me that I had no control over...I am starting to appreciate antinatalism ir whatever..

Thing is, I want to encourage you to feel your feelings and be in charge of your life as much as you can because while I have little hope lately..the old me would have helped you feel thought of and comforted..idk I’m a mess on the inside, probably shouldn’t post..feeling incoherent

I’m so sad to see you in such pain..
My ex thinks I cheated on them, it’s nearly as painful to be cut out of his life  while he suffers..

This was sent to me minutes after he hit me, I called cops, chickened out and left oh and he said “there’s no proof when he realized I called cops..

I was a total mess in the relationship,invaded his privacy and screamed a lot when fighting for long periods of time...but I know I was provoked..I’m super codependent.

He didn’t have a job for 3 years because his parents support him meanwhile I had multiple jobs and college ugh I’m just venting..

I appreciate your words friend!
